title: Undertrials During the year 1997, the highest number of undertrial prisoners (37,198) in various jails was reported from Uttar Pradesh. This was followed by Bihar (36801) and Madhya Pradesh (21010). The other states which also reported high number of undertrials in their custody during 1997 were Maharashtra (14142), Tamil Nadu (10995), Andhra Pradesh (9623), Rajasthan (6526), Karnataka (6380), Punjab (5723), Haryana (56094) and UT of Delhi (7844). Some of the States had large number of the undertrials kept in the Central Jail. The number of undertrials kept in the Central Jail of the various ‘States were Maharashtra (8852), Tamil Nadu (7787), Madhya Pradesh (4249), Karnataka (3506), Andhra Pradesh (3183), Punjab (2691), Rajasthan (1876), Gujarat (1225) and Uttar Pradesh (1099) and UT of Delhi (7844). The other states had either kept most of the undertrials in district jails or sub jails. Uttar Pradesh (35045), Madhya Pradesh (7961), Maharashtra (5081), Assam (4105), Rajasthan (2966), Orissa
